descriptions.value: In authenticate of verify_image, there is a possible Signature verification logic bypass due to a logic error in the code. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with execution privileges needed. User interaction is for exploitation.
Time-of-check time-of-use (toctou) race condition in Microsoft Office Click-To-Run allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.
